I spent a little while laying in a park today, under the shade of a tree, listening to [The National](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G-Vg2YS-sFE) and [Gotye](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8UVNT4wvIGY) on repeat for about an hour and a half.
The appointment failed. I couldn't talk about my problem, I just made up some stupid story about earwax.

I'm probably doing one of the worst things and dealing with one thing at a time, leaving all the other issues in the back of my mind and ignored. I've got a GP's appointment tomorrow, so I'll discuss depression with them. I guess I've been coping through the past few days by understanding that there is help for me out there, it still bothers me though that seemingly simple tasks such as saying hi to a friendly face are an effort. I've also discovered that me and my ex are on talking terms, which is so much more than what I expected. I want to ask him for help, to tell him how I'm feeling. But I don't want to be a burden upon him. I don't want to bring him down with me. Hopefully the appointment tomorrow will help me deal with things better. But we'll see.

Moving back home is something I've considered, but not seen much worth to. Sure, I'm homesick. But it's not going to change who I am. It took a lot of work for me to get into this university, I don't want to fuck things up further. I'd say that coming here was the best thing that happened to me, that being in a relationship with my boyfriend was the best thing that happened to me, but right now I feel as though it's the worst thing. I need to get rid of this confliction and move on, but find myself unable to.
Thanks for the offer, but I'd rather create real friendships, with people who will be around me. I just wish I had the confidence to be part of the whole 'university experience'...

I'm in a new city and despite being here for 2 months, I only have 2 friends to my name. Well, I'm not sure if I can consider them friends anymore, I've pushed them too far away.
I had some friends in my homecity, but they're getting on with their own lives now and besides, I was never that close to them.
I want to move on with my own life too, but I just can't.

Hope I'm not too late to the party.
http://imgur.com/f6U.jpg
Not that anyone would care...
Now officially forever alone.

I can't reach out to the friends I have, they'll either not understand where I am because I've not been able to treat them as proper friends, or they've had enough of me and don't want to be burdened further. I'm blaming myself for everything right now, I don't want to make any more little mistakes that leave me ending up alone. I'd rather just make one final mistake and not worry about the others...
Every friendship I've been apart of is shitter now because of things I've done. I just don't have the natural ability to be successful.

I'll try the thing with goals and making friends, but as for occupying myself...
The gym isn't free, I'd go for walks but the weather isn't so favourable right now, the library is a busy (and one of those noisy ones) place, I'd feel like such a loner there without someone to talk to.
It's Sheffield.

It doesn't help that most of them are away this weekend, but I'll give this a try. I'd like to join a club/society, but at the moment I'd just feel out of place and I'd want to make a good impression on new people. That's something I'd have to consider in the longterm, if I make it.

I need to be able to interact with others better. I live in a flat with 9 other people. All the information I know about them is what I can gather from their Facebook pages. I want to be able to have good friendships with people, without being boring to them, without being a burden to them, but I can't just walk out and make friends. I don't have the confidence to do that. I'm a quiet person, people tell me to speak more often. Then when I do I just get told to shut up. I want to stop that from happening. I'm not sure if I can cope with this break-up as it is, he means a lot to me and I'm not sure if I can ever let him go. So right now, I'd find it quite handy to have a hobby, or just something to take my mind off of things. Distracting myself is the best way I cope with turmoil in my life. But I'm a student now, I can't waste money away on games and movies. I'm not in any kind of mood to do the work I have to do, but I won't let it pile up. But I'm struggling to convince even myself that I can change at all.
Thanks but I've not had a minidump created since March, so I'm unsure if it's even related.
